 cryptographic proof-of-stake mechanism can secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks by anchoring identity validation to staked computational capital. Attackers attempting to spawn fake nodes face a hollow economic reward structure, as collateral requirements scale exponentially beyond their resources. Much like a reinforced jetty withstands a turbulent ocean plume, this staked barrier absorbs malicious identity floods, rendering mass fabrication economically non-viable.
